column3: The Hebrew says the nations came into the inheritance rather than invaded it.
The Hebrew has corpse in the singular and explicitly says birds of the heavens.
The Hebrew does not explicitly add the dead.
The Hebrew says did not know and did not call, without explicitly saying refused.
The Hebrew's first verb is singular, he devoured, followed by a plural they devastated; it says his dwelling.
The Hebrew asks that compassion meet us and explicitly says we have become very low.
The Hebrew asks that vengeance become known; Your does not explicitly qualify vengeance.
The Hebrew has a singular captive and calls those to be spared sons of death.
The Hebrew connects this with and rather than then.
